descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name מַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ / מַעֲשֵׂיָה (Maaseyahu/Maaseiah), meaning 'work of Yah,' borne by numerous individuals across the Hebrew Bible including a Levitical musician (1 Chr 15:18,20), the governor of Jerusalem under Josiah (2 Chr 34:8), various priests and officials (Ezra 10:18,21,22,30; Neh 3:23, 8:4,7, 10:25, 11:5,7, 12:41,42), the father of Zephaniah the priest (Jer 21:1, 29:21,25, 37:3), and the father of the temple gatekeeper Zedekiah (Jer 35:4). Multilingual evidence: eng Maaseyah/Maaseiah, spa Maaseyah/Maasías, hin माअसेयाह/मासेयाहू, arb مَعَشِيَا/مَعَسِيَّا, kor 마아세야, swa Maaseya. The long form (מַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ) and short form (מַעֲשֵׂיָה) are orthographic variants of the same name.
